<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX10_2025-02-0609-38-54" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon" part="M" next="exX10_2025-11-1013-12-45">

            <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5526">tshad ma'i bstan bcos gzhan phyogs zil gnon rigs pa'i mtshon cha</rs> zhes bya ba | ming gzhan <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5526">grub mtha' sna tshogs bshad pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i sgron me</rs> 'di ni sngon gyi <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="4593">slob dpon</rs> <lb n="188a6"/> dag gi gzhung lugs du ma mthong zhing thos te de dag gsal la ma 'dres par rigs pa dang grol bar smra ba'i spobs pa can <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4006">yul dbus kyi btsun pa rigs pa'i ral gri</rs>s bkod do ||</seg></TEI>
